doc: The single promise catalog: ids a test module may name with pytest.mark.promise. families declares every id family; an id whose family is not declared is rejected. Add a family by declaring it here (ids then read P-<FAMILY>-<id>), and add an id when a new test protects a promise that is not listed yet.

families.P-DOC: Documented-surface promises: the reference docs and guides describe the shipped CLI (P-DOC-<id>).
families.P-LAW: Lifecycle laws: every property_catalog id in tests/fixtures/lifecycle_bug_ledger.json, verbatim (P-LAW-<id>).
families.req: OpenAPM spec requirement ids as written in CONFORMANCE.json (req-xx-NNN).
